cardOverview.overviewText: A luxury lifestyle card offering high reward rates, global concierge services, lounge access, and milestone benefits, targeted at premium spenders seeking exclusivity.

benefitRows.name: Axis Dining Delight
benefitRows.offer: Enjoy exclusive offers on dining via EazyDiner.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the Axis Dining Delights program using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy up to 15% savings at 10,000+ partner restaurants. Complete the payment using your Axis Olympus credit card to unlock the offer.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: Get up to ₹650 off on every movie ticket purchased on the BookMyShow website or mobile app, and up to ₹1,000 off on every non-movie ticket for the second ticket.|This benefit can be availed up to 2 times for movie tickets and 2 times for non-movie tickets per customer each month.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.
